thread:
infra-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: serving-pool-7 - increased container restarts (OOM) and CUDA error spikes reported. auto-escalation -> eng-oncall.
Sam (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a steady memory creep on several GPUs, nodes 7a/7b/7c. containers are restarting every ~6-12m.
Mira: any immediate customer impact?
Sam (oncall): Some production requests are falling back to smaller model variants; ~18% error rate on a single shard, ~7% across the pool. CS flagged a small set of customers with latency spikes.
Thomas: logs? paste if possible.
Sam (oncall): Pasting truncated logs + stack hints:
```
[2026-03-15T08:12:43Z] runtime: allocation failed: tried to allocate 33554432 bytes
[2026-03-15T08:12:43Z] cuda: cuMemAlloc returned CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY on device 0
[2026-03-15T08:12:43Z] runtime: kv_cache: slab_alloc() failed - free_pages=12 slab_frag=0.92
[2026-03-15T08:12:44Z] containerd: killing container serving-runtime pid=2345 OOM
```
Sam (oncall): metrics show gradual resident growth ~60MB/min on the allocator worker threads. This looks like paged-attention allocator + KV cache fragmentation rather than a sudden leak.
Jess: are the sweeper jobs running? last week sweep-offset was failing on 7b.
Sam (oncall): sweeper pod logs show backpressure and a few timeouts. evict job queued but fail rate rising.
Mira: quick query from metrics (prom):
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_alloc_bytes_total[5m])) by (node) -> nodes 7a:+1.1Mi/s, 7b:+0.9Mi/s, 7c:+1.3Mi/s
kv_cache_frag_ratio{node="7b"} = 0.91
paged_attn_page_count{node="7b"} = 124300
paged_attn_free_pages{node="7b"} = 14
```
Mira: that frag ratio is bad. with free pages in low double digits, allocator attempts small allocations but ends up failing due to fragmentation.
Thomas: can we force compaction? any admin endpoint?
Sam (oncall): There's /admin/kv/compact but it's opt-in and can be expensive. I want to avoid cluster-wide pauses. Alternative: stagger node drains + restart runtime process to clear per-process resident set.
ops-bot: Suggested action: set KV_CACHE_SOFT_EVICT=0.6 on affected nodes, then restart runtime in rolling fashion.
Jess: can we bump sweep frequency and increase eviction aggressiveness for 30m to test?
Sam (oncall): plan: 1) switch routing off node 7b (take it out of LB) 2) increase evict aggressiveness via env toggle on 7a/7c 3) restart runtime on 7b to release stuck pages 4) monitor 20m. If healthy, continue 7a/7c one at a time.
Mira: I can run the LB drain and restart steps. Sam, can you prepare the commands?
Sam (oncall): commands below. do not run concurrently across nodes.
```
# drain node
kubectl annotate node gpu-7b serving/redwood-drain=true --overwrite
kubectl cordon gpu-7b
kubectl drain gpu-7b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# toggle evict (via patching ds env)
kubectl set env daemonset/serving-runtime KV_CACHE_SOFT_EVICT=0.6 -n serving
# restart runtime on node (force new pod)
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/serving-runtime -n serving --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-7b
```
Mira: running drain on 7b now. will post statuses. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam (oncall): while that's ongoing, run this quick check to identify per-pod fragmentation:
```
curl -s http://metrics.internal:9090/api/v1/query?query="paged_attn_free_pages%20%3C%2016%20and%20kv_cache_frag_ratio%20%3E%200.85" | jq .
```
Thomas: FYI I see one container with repeated "cudaMemcpyAsync failed - invalid argument" before OOM. might be a symptom of corrupted KV index after fragmentation.
Jess: cc @Customer Success: will update customers in the affected shard list once we have better ETA.
Customer Success Bot: Noted - please add customer IDs when you have them and we will send targeted updates.
Sam (oncall): drain succeeded, pod evicted. starting restart now (7b).
ops-bot: rollout restart triggered for daemonset/serving-runtime. new pod scheduled on gpu-7b -> pod serving-runtime-7b-rt2.
Sam (oncall): new pod came up clean. initial memory baseline is 8.1Gi reserved vs old ~12.4Gi. good sign.
Mira: monitoring shows immediate drop in allocation rate on 7b. paged_attn_free_pages -> 256, frag_ratio -> 0.42.
Sam (oncall): rolling to 7a next, but we saw a minor regression after patching env on 7a: a small uptick in tail latency (95th) from 220ms -> 260ms for 6m. reverting evict to 0.7 fixed it.
Mira: decision: revert evasive global change. instead we'll use node-level restarts + targeted eviction on worst nodes. Jess please coordinate CS messages.
Jess: composing update now. timeline estimate: cascading restarts for 3 nodes, full mitigation within 1.5 hrs, but we'll extend communication window to 3 hrs in case of relapses.
Thomas: suggest a short-term hotfix to allocator: commit https://git.internal/redwood/serving/commit/ab12f3c - it enables small-block coalescing on paged-attn to fight fragmentation. can we cherry-pick to stable branch and promote to canary?
Sam (oncall): +1 to canary. we need to validate it under production-like loads. propose: canary to single node (gpu-7d) with synthetic workload for 30m, if stable then roll.
Mira: canary started on 7d with traffic split 1%. monitoring for 20m now.
ops-bot: Canary metrics: paged_attn_frag_ratio@7d pre=0.89 post=0.58, mem-growth slowed from 65MB/min to 12MB/min.
Sam (oncall): promising. schedule full rollout but staggered and only if no customer regressions.
Mira: handoff notes for next oncall (Mira -> Thomas in 2h):
- root cause: pacing fragment accumulation in kv cache + paged-attn allocator; small-page fragmentation leads to OOM at allocation time despite free backing memory.
- mitigations taken: drained and restarted nodes 7b -> cleared fragmentation; increased targeted eviction on worst nodes briefly; canary patch rolled to 7d (good).
- outstanding: complete staggered roll of allocator patch across pool, keep sweep frequency + eviction tuned for 4h, watch for regressions.
- customer impact: ~18% of requests on shard hit fallback briefly; 4 customers reported 5-10% error spike; no data loss. CS notified and waiting updates.
- commands: see pinned snippets earlier.
Thomas: copying notes. I'll take full rollout if current 30m hold looks clean.
Sam (oncall): final: created incident ticket INC-2026-314 in tracker with RCA placeholders. linking commit and metrics charts. :white_check_mark:
Mira: thanks team. handing off monitoring to Thomas in 2h. adding JIRA + timeline in ticket. :thumbsup:
Jess: sent PSAT to affected customers and opened follow-up support cases.
Customer Success Bot: customer updates sent to affected list.
Sam (oncall): marking here for future postmortem: improve sweeper retry logic, add forced compaction endpoint with safety interlocks, and add allocator fragmentation alert (frag_ratio > 0.85 for 10m).
Thomas: noted. will own follow-ups.
Sam (oncall): handing off now. good job everyone.
Mira: thanks, handing to Thomas. :wave:
